The material culture of the Realm

The system beyond
the printed garment.

Apparel carries the declaration. Boxes, tissue, appointment cards, wax seals, standards, and provenance records carry the institution. These founding studies establish the materials from which each House and Order now draws.

A note from the wardrobe

The House confers authority.
It does not issue decoration.

The peacock, parrot, notification shield, Wi-Fi crown, seals, standards, Latin, and calligraphy constitute the ceremonial library. Their use is reserved for garments possessing recognized standing before the court.
